invention.ref: Earliest datable reservoir pen of the type described by Nicholas Bion
invention.ref_zh: 比翁所描述类型的储墨笔，最早一支刻有 1702 年

locations.place_label_zh: 法国巴黎（比翁 / 波埃纳鲁）

notes: 钢笔没有单一发明者：1702 年的储墨笔形制见于比翁的著作，1809 年英国 Fölsch 获首个专利，1827 年罗马尼亚人波埃纳鲁获法国专利，19 世纪末纽约的 Waterman 等品牌让它普及。本条目以 1702 年为发明年。
summary_zh: 储墨笔最早可追溯到 1702 年；1809 年英国出现首个钢笔专利，1827 年波埃纳鲁在法国获得鹅毛管储墨笔专利。
summary_en: Reservoir pens date to at least 1702; England granted its first fountain-pen patent in 1809, and Petrache Poenaru received a French patent in 1827.

image.alt_en: A fountain pen nib writing on paper

notes_en: No single inventor: Bion documented the reservoir pen (earliest dated 1702), Fölsch got the first English patent in 1809, Poenaru a French patent in 1827, and late-19th-century makers such as Waterman in New York made it common. This entry uses 1702 as invention.
